title: Security and operations: agent skills for TYPO3
description: Harden the installation, give every editor exactly the rights they need, run the right scheduled jobs and check the project repository. For each skill: the prompt you would type and what it does. Narrated, with selectable captions.
alt: Film, 97 seconds: Security and operations, 4 agent skills for TYPO3 v14 (typo3-security, typo3-backend-rights, typo3-scheduler-jobs, typo3-site-conformance). Each skill with its own prompt and what it delivers. Narrated, with selectable captions.

transcript.text: Editors with exactly the rights they need, and an installation that is hardened and runs the right jobs.
Security and operations: four skills for TYPO3 v14.
Hardens a v14 installation: trusted hosts, the Install Tool, two-factor sign-in, CSP and safe queries.
It fixes the classic findings the TYPO3 way: user input concatenated into SQL becomes a QueryBuilder query with bound values.
Builds and audits editor groups, page and language rights, MFA and login branding.
The lab fails: three groups, no leaves, 56 findings.
Plans and checks the Scheduler tasks an installation needs, with groups and safe intervals.
It finds jobs that are missing, late or ungrouped, and repairs task rows left without a type after a v14 update.
Scores a deployable project with Docker or Compose against a gold standard.
It is the project counterpart to typo3-conformance, which checks single extensions.
Open source. Clone the skills, and help us improve them.
